name: Upfling.host
description:
Upfling is static website hosting for people who write sites with an AI assistant. Connect it once, sign in with your Upfling account, and the assistant can publish and manage your sites from the conversation.

What you can ask for:

* Publish a page. "Deploy this HTML as a live site called portfolio." The site is online at portfolio.upfling.site in about 20 seconds, with SSL.
* Change something. "Fix the typo in index.html on my-portfolio and redeploy." Only the file you name changes.
* Add files. Images, fonts and PDFs go up through an upload step the assistant handles for you.
* Look things up. "Which of my sites mention pricing?" or "Summarise the about page on my-shop." The assistant searches your sites and reads the pages you ask about.
* Check your account. Plan, storage used, how many sites you can still create.

How it behaves:

* Everything runs against your own account only. Signing in grants the assistant permission to read your sites, and separately to change them; you approve both on the sign-in screen and can remove the connection from your assistant's settings at any time.
* Reading is unrestricted; writing asks first. Tools that replace files, delete files or delete a site are marked destructive, so the assistant confirms before running them.
* Nothing goes live half-way. A new site is published only when every file is in place, and a deleted site sits in the trash for 14 days before it is gone.
* Plan limits are the same as in the dashboard: one site and 25 MB on Free, more on paid plans.

You need an Upfling account (upfling.host, free to start). Upfling adds no tracking to the sites you publish.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Upfling.host to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Upfling.host to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.upfling.host/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Upfling.host MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upfling.host lists 15 MCP tools, including confirm_upload, create_site, delete_site, delete_site_files, fetch, get_account_info, get_site, list_site_files, list_sites, read_site_file, replace_site_files, and request_upload.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Upfling.host?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Upfling.host in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Upfling.host requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Upfling.host is developed by Upfling. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
